```{r}
detected_mask = ifelse(maf_object@clinical.data$micromet_detection_by_ihc == "YES", T, F)
```

```{r}
undetected_mask = ifelse(maf_object@clinical.data$micromet_detection_by_ihc == "NO", T, F)
```


```{r}
detected_barcode = maf_object@clinical.data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[detected_mask]
undetected_barcode = maf_object@clinical.data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[undetected_mask]
```

```{r}
detected_object = subsetMaf(maf = maf_object, tsb = detected_barcode)
```

```{r}
undetected_object = subsetMaf(maf = maf_object, tsb = undetected_barcode)
```

```{r}
coOncoplot(m1 = detected_object, m2 = undetected_object, m1Name = "YES", m2Name = "NO")
```

#CDH1 makes a protein E-cadherin, which helps the epithelial cells and surpresses cancer
#CDH1 is part of cancer supression. A lack of this gene could lead to a wider spread of cancer, leading to the ihc deleting it. 



```{r}
CDH1_maf = subsetMaf(maf = maf_object,
genes = "CDH1")
mutation_status = ifelse(maf_object@clinical.data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode %in% CDH1_maf@clinical.data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, "positive", "negative")
contingency_table <-table(mutation_status, detected_mask)
contingency_table
fisher.test(contingency_table)
mosaicplot(contingency_table)
```
# The odds ratio is 1.73, meaning the odds of a positive micrometastasis result are about 1.73 times higher in CDH1-mutated samples than in CDH1-negative samples.
#The p value is less than 0.05, making it statistically signifigant. 

```{r}
lollipopPlot2(m1 = detected_object, m2 = undetected_object, m1_name = "Micromets detected", m2_name = "No Micromets detected", gene = "CDH1")

```

#There is no difference where the mutations are located between the two. However, using the numbers you can tell that with micromets detected there is a higher mutation rate. 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```

```{r}
my_maf = maf_object
my_maf@clinical.data$Overall_Survival_Status = ifelse(my_maf@clinical.data$vital_status == "alive", T, F)
```

```{r}
mafSurvival(maf = my_maf,
genes = "CDH1",
time = "last_contact_days_to",
Status = "Overall_Survival_Status")
```

# a insignifigant p value shows that there is no signifigant relashionship between survivorship of a mutant vs non-mutant gene. This p-value is insignifigant because the p-value is above 0.05. We cannot make any coonclusions from this survivorship curve. This shows that even if CDH1 mutations spread, there is no correlation on survival.
